requirements.name: component-type
requirements.message:
Every electrical component prim MUST carry `pcba:component:type`, a token from
`resistor capacitor inductor led diode transistor connector crystal switch ic other`. It is
authored / classified — **not inferred from the refdes prefix**.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 8 and 8.1.

requirements.name: process-class
requirements.message:
Every placed component prim MUST carry `pcba:component:processClass` — **how the part is
mounted** — from `SMT through_hole press_fit mechanical fiducial Mixed`. A `Mixed` part MUST
also list its real mount technologies in `pcba:component:processClasses`. Package families
(BGA, LGA, QFN, …) are not mount methods; they belong in `packageType`.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 8, 8.1 and 12.

requirements.name: part-identity
requirements.message:
Part identity is two independent groups: `pcba:component:mpn` + `pcba:component:manufacturer`
(the **manufacturer's** part identity) and `pcba:component:value` + `pcba:component:tolerance`
(the **electrical requirement** set by the designer). Both are CONDITIONAL: author them when
known and use null / empty — never an invented value — where not. `pcba:component:customerPartNumber`
(the board owner's internal part number) is also CONDITIONAL and often the only identity present
at design time.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, section 8.

requirements.name: refdes-identity
requirements.message:
Every electrical component MUST carry `pcba:component:refdes`, the reference designator, unique
**within one board**. `fiducial` and `mechanical` placements SHOULD carry one; when they do not,
they MUST carry `pcba:component:instanceId` so the placement stays addressable. A placed
component MUST be discoverable by at least one of `refdes`, `instanceId`, or `processClass` —
never by prim name.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 3, 8 and 8.1.

requirements.name: package-type
requirements.message:
Every electrical component SHOULD carry `pcba:component:packageType` — a **string** naming the
package designation that identifies a specific physical body: a published standard (JEDEC,
JEITA, EIA, IEC — `QFN-48`, `0402`, `DIP-8`, `TO-99`) or, failing that, the manufacturer's
package designation. Not a lead-form or family word.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, section 8.

requirements.name: component-manifest
requirements.message:
The board MUST provide a component manifest: one record per placed component linking its BOM
identity, its footprint, and its component asset. This is realized **without a separate sidecar**
— the per-instance `pcba:component:*` attributes plus the prim's prototype `reference` are that
record, distributed across the stage, and the `pcba:board:members` registry indexes it.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 3, 4 and 8.

requirements.name: footprint-id
requirements.message:
Every electrical component MUST carry `pcba:component:footprintId`, identifying the
**footprint** — the set of pads (and holes, for THT) the part lands on — in the source CAD
library. When that id is source-specific, the prim MUST also carry
`pcba:component:sourceOrigin`, which says where the footprint came from and therefore how far
to trust it.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 1.1 and 8.
